items.text: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith officially off injury report, good to go for MNF vs Bears. Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.implication: Full go for PHI stars vs CHI (Williams out).
items.opportunity: Barkley lead back; Smith WR1 targets.

items.text: Caleb Williams ruled OUT for MNF vs Eagles. Tyson Bagent questionable after returning to practice.
items.why: Official ruling; Bagent full participant but Q.
items.implication: CHI offense downgrade; Bagent start likely.
items.opportunity: PHI defense boost; limited CHI pass catchers.

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT for Sunday. Hamstring injury keeps him sidelined second straight week.
items.why: Did not practice all week; official OUT designation.
items.implication: Dalton Schultz elevated target share (30% routes last week); other HOU WRs see bump.
items.opportunity: Schultz TE1 upside vs IND allowing 4th-most TE yards.

items.text: Rico Dowdle listed OUT. Toe injury; Jaylen Warren expected to lead PIT backfield.
items.why: Ruled out; coach comments confirm Warren as lead with breathers.
items.implication: Warren lead back + checkdown volume from Rodgers.
items.opportunity: Warren high snap/touch share; Homer/Heidenreich backups.

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite Q tags. Clarity needed on Flowers, Moore, Mitchell.
items.why: ETR projections have them in; LP or positive signs.
items.implication: Start with confidence if active; monitor early news.

items.text: Puka Nacua DOUBTFUL for Sunday. Not expected to play; Adams can carry load.
items.why: Hip/groin issues; Rapoport confirms not expected.
items.implication: Adams primary WR1 volume for LAR.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT. Mariota starts; positive longer-term news, not IR.
items.why: Official OUT; Rapoport notes good news on avoiding IR.
items.implication: McLaurin still viable but lower floor vs SEA; Mariota game manager.
items.opportunity: Limited for WAS pass catchers short-term.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead PIT RBs; expect heavy checkdowns as vertical game failed. Homer and Heidenreich as backups.
items.why: Coach: Warren leads, freshen with breathers. Rodgers checkdown lean.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + targets in pass game.

items.text: LOVE Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% target share / 30% routes w/ Collins out last week; IND 4th-most TE yards allowed.
items.why: Fact: elevated role confirmed; soft TE matchup.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR ceiling record at 44.0 (top 25th %ile sim avg) in Week 3 projections.
items.why: Elite sim outcomes in main slate projections.

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL: highest rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.implication: Strong RB1 start in Brazil game.

items.text: LOVE Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both weeks; RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
LOVE Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both weeks, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.opportunity: High target share vs weak secondary.

items.text: HATE Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: post-fumble only 31% snaps/5 touches; JAX stout vs RBs (55 rush ypg, 3.2 ypc). Still ranks him over Henderson.
items.why: Usage drop after fumble + tough matchup; Henderson 65% snaps/16 touches remainder.
items.opportunity: Henderson rising but Stevenson still preferred short-term.
items.conflict: Usage favors Henderson post-fumble but Berry ranks Stevenson ahead.
